dev.sub: Aemeath provides 16 fixed virtual device slots. A slot is plugged in automatically while a node occupies it and unplugged when no node does, so unused slots stay out of the Windows device list. Device names are fixed; the devices are removed only when Aemeath is uninstalled.
dev.outputsSub: Apps such as OBS record from these
dev.freeSub: Plugs in when a node uses it
dev.fmtSame: Same as the engine · no resampling
dev.fmtDiff: Differs from the engine sample rate · silent until slot resampling arrives
dev.note: Aemeath sets each virtual device to the engine sample rate when it is first plugged in. Changing a device format briefly disconnects any app that is using that device, such as OBS.

reg.title: Preparing virtual devices
reg.body: Aemeath is setting up its 16 virtual devices. The first time, Windows installs a driver for each one, which can take about a minute.
